name: North Star Technologies
heroLine: Every day our team does the plumbing, electrical and mechanical work to make spaces habitable, so we can build and test the frontier technologies that will one day be used in habitats only accessible via space.
vision: Bring technologies from esoteric fields into mission-ready tools.
magic: A tool built on technology you do not fully know is indistinguishable from magic.
description: North Star Technologies adds capabilities to humanity by bringing technologies from esoteric fields into mission-ready tools. It starts with the mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems that make spaces reliably habitable. Service work is performed by Click Plumbing.
